title: Decide where the operator is legally established, then re-derive HF-05
description: Audit AUD-03 joined to the ADR-0007 verification gap. ADR-0007's GPSR distributor conclusion likely survives regardless of establishment - role follows from whether you place goods on the market. But the EPR consequences drawn in market-selection.md HF-05 depend on it, and REG-06 (Authorised Representative for non-established sellers) dates 2026-08-12. HF-05 is currently underivable. Also opens the missing commercial/legal layer: zero occurrences of GDPR, privacy, personal data, legal entity, invoice, KYC in the corpus; one mention of VAT; no PSP decision though iDEAL is called a launch requirement; no DPA though every order sends customer personal data to a supplier.

title: Record the organic-search premise as a risk and hang INV-08 on it
description: Audit AUD-02 joined to the INV-08 finding. The premise: attribute-generated copy, in a language the operator does not speak, on the same distributor feeds every competitor has, can win Dutch organic. Second failure mode, from the auditor: the operator cannot assess the quality of that content himself, so the premise can fail SILENTLY - months of output with no internal signal that it is not working. INV-08's second term (CWV/SEO above maintenance and time-to-launch) exists only if the premise holds; ADR-0001, ADR-0002 and ADR-0003 are downstream of that ordering. Blocks the INV-08 half of docs-i6p.
close_reason: ASM-03 recorded in 00-product/assumptions.md with both failure modes, and as a structural risk in vision.md. Paid traffic named as the fallback, which upgrades SC-08 from deferrable to blocking. INV-08 demoted to ASM-02 and hung on ASM-03.

title: Justify or retire INV-01, INV-03, INV-07, INV-08 - four invariants with no decision record
description: Four invariants are stated as fact with no ADR deriving them: INV-01 (one Magento instance for 10-20 websites at feed scale, an untested capacity bet), INV-03, INV-07, INV-08. Audit 2026-08-04 joins this to AUD-07 (Phase -1 exit gate is a 19x3 matrix that exists nowhere as a matrix) and to the docs-check weakness: one pattern, not three defects. The repo declares a constraint and never builds the instrument that could falsify it. Remedy for all three together: for every asserted constraint, name what would disprove it.
close_reason: INV-01 -> ASM-01 and INV-08 -> ASM-02, both with falsifiers. INV-03 derivation named (automation charter), with an OPEN on deriving an invariant from a living doc. INV-07 derivation found to exist in ADR-0001 and ADR-0003 but mislabelled INV-05 - completing it is docs-cn2, not this issue.

title: Decide ADR-0005 - catalog data layer
description: Last blocking ADR. Constraints already fixed by ADR-0006 and ADR-0007 are recorded in the ADR itself.

title: Confirm or reject the first market and vertical
description: market-selection.md recommends the Netherlands and a segment of hand tools / workshop consumables. Confirm against the two verification tasks, then record the choice.

title: Pull and inspect a real sample feed from a named NL-warehoused distributor
description: Produces three answers at once: identifier quality (open in ADR-0006), SKU count and cadence and delta-vs-snapshot (inputs to ADR-0005), and evidence the goods are already placed on the EU market (INV-10).

title: Keyword-level organic competition analysis, Dutch, 2-3 candidate segments
description: market-selection.md names this as the one criterion (MC-04) it could not settle from public sources. Need search volume, top-10 domain strength, and whether bol.com and the incumbent DIY chains hold the head terms.

title: Name the acquisition scope boundary in the automation charter
description: Audit AUD-01, narrowed. VC-04 already covers product-level copy with a publishability rule; what is genuinely absent is market-level work - translation and localisation, SEO assets (category copy, meta, internal linking), merchandising. Prefer the audit's second remedy over the first: do not append VC-20+. VC stages have an owner component, a contract and a state machine; merchandising has no trigger-vs-judgement answer in the same sense and forcing it in dilutes the instrument. State the boundary and name the doc that owns acquisition.

title: Harden docs-check.py to the conventions it claims to enforce
description: Verified 2026-08-04 with six probes, confirmed by the auditor. The orphan check is inert for every ROUTED directory - line 67 passes any file whose parent directory string appears anywhere in INDEX.md, and the routing table names all nine. It DOES fire for a directory absent from INDEX.md entirely (a probe in 80-new/ was caught). Design constraint for the fix: an explicit path match is not enough, because 60-decisions/, 50-runbooks/ and 70-tenants/ are legitimately routed at directory level - they need either an in-area index or an explicit exemption list, or the fix becomes noise on every new ADR. Also unvalidated: paths in related: frontmatter, and markdown [](...) links (only backticked .md paths are checked).

title: Define the procedure for correcting an error in a frozen document
description: CONVENTIONS says ADRs are frozen on acceptance and never edited. It gives no way to fix an error in one. Blocking a real fix: ADR-0001:25, ADR-0001:26 and ADR-0003:31 cite INV-05 (dropshipping) where INV-07 (no proprietary vendor runtime) is meant - the wrong constraint quoted as justification. Options: an erratum block, a superseding ADR, or an explicit carve-out for factual corrections that do not change the decision.

title: Verify beads sync round-trips from a fresh clone
description: bd dolt push reported success but nothing has been pulled back on a second machine or clone. Until that is tested, the durability of the queue is assumed, not known.

title: Resolve the three beads-vs-harness collisions
description: bd prime forbids TodoWrite/TaskCreate for task tracking, forbids MEMORY.md in favour of bd remember, and ships its own session-close protocol that overlaps CONVENTIONS.md. Each needs a call: adopt, reject, or scope. Leaving them unresolved means two sets of rules.

title: Verify the version claims in c4-container.md against primary sources
description: OpenSearch 2.19+, Valkey 8 / Redis 7.2, Varnish 7.6/7.7, PHP 8.4, and 'Elasticsearch removed in Magento 2.4.8' are stated as fact and none was verified. CONVENTIONS requires explicit versions; explicit and wrong is worse than vague.

title: Decide whether an invariant may be derived from a living doc (INV-03)
description: INV-03's derivation is the automation charter, which is status: living. A living doc can change without an ADR, so the invariant's justification can move underneath it. Either freeze the reasoning in an ADR, or accept the coupling explicitly and say why.

Read audit-2026-08-04.md section by section - it now lives inside the repo, so the queue no longer depends on an unversioned file. Retire it to 90-archive once every finding is dispositioned; do not delete it.

The regulatory citations are solid; the market figures are the soft spot if the recommendation is challenged.
